description: Audit a domain's SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, alignment, BIMI, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT setup and check it against free public blocklists (not Spamhaus) when troubleshooting email authentication or spam delivery. Takes a domain, optional checks and DKIM selectors, and fresh=true to bypass cached results. Returns a graded scorecard, findings, proposed DNS fixes and a public report permalink. Uses DNS and policy-file lookups; never changes DNS or guarantees inbox placement.

dkim_selectors.description: Extra DKIM selectors to probe, e.g. google, s1

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com

name: diagnose_domain
title: Diagnose email domain
